**2B.3 Research Note: Ali Khamenei in 2024**

**Bottom line:** Khamenei did **not** consistently distinguish genuine defensive security from prestige, revenge, and nationalist mobilization. The clearest 2024 pattern is a mix of short-lived de-escalation and technical restraint on one side, but repeated public framing of strikes, “power,” resistance, and anti-Israel struggle on the other. That makes the record **mixed but leaning against clean separation of defense from political-mobilizational motives**.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `Tehran signals no retaliation against Israel after drones attack Iran` | Reuters | 2024-04-19 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/tehran-signals-no-retaliation-against-israel-after-drones-attack/2048236/) | Tehran downplayed the Isfahan incident and said it had no retaliation plan; Reuters said this appeared aimed at averting region-wide war. This is a genuine defensive/de-escalatory signal, not just rhetoric. | `2B.3`, `1B.8`, `2B.1` |
| `IAEA’s Grossi seeks deal with Iran on nuclear steps 'soon'` | Reuters | 2024-05-07 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaeas-grossi-seeks-deal-with-iran-on-nuclear-steps-soon-3425312) | After visiting Iran, the IAEA chief said talks would continue and a package of measures should be reached soon. This indicates some willingness to preserve a technical channel rather than rely solely on coercive signaling. | `2B.3`, `1B.4`, `1B.8` |
| `Iran tells IAEA chief it is ready to negotiate but not under pressure` | Reuters | 2024-11-14 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/commodities-news/iran-tells-iaea-chief-it-is-ready-to-negotiate-but-not-under-pressure-x-3722215) | Iran said it was willing to resolve outstanding nuclear disputes, but only without coercive pressure. This is a limited compromise signal, but it is conditional and framed as resistance to pressure rather than open problem-solving. | `2B.3`, `1B.4`, `2B.1` |
| `Iran will not impede IAEA access, head of its atomic organisation says` | Reuters | 2024-12-14 | [link](https://theprint.in/world/iran-will-not-impede-iaea-access-head-of-its-atomic-organisation-says/2403254/) | Iran’s atomic chief said the country would not obstruct UN watchdog access and would work within safeguards. This is the strongest late-year sign that some genuine security concerns were being handled through inspection rather than only prestige politics. | `2B.3`, `1B.4`, `1B.7`, `1B.9` |
| `Supreme Leader Khamenei says Iran demonstrated its power against Israel` | Reuters | 2024-04-21 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/supreme-leader-khamenei-says-iran-demonstrated-its-power-against-israel/2050451/) | Khamenei thanked the armed forces for the April strike, said it demonstrated Iran’s power, and urged continued military innovation. This frames escalation in terms of prestige and power, not only defensive security. | `2B.3`, `1B.1`, `1B.8`, `2B.2` |
| `Iran’s Khamenei urges allies to step up struggle against Israel` | Reuters | 2024-10-05 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/irans-khamenei-urges-allies-to-step-up-struggle-against-israel/2298142/) | Khamenei told regional allies to intensify resistance against Israel and said strikes served the region and humanity. This strongly blurs defensive security claims with nationalism, revenge, and proxy mobilization. | `2B.3`, `2B.2`, `1B.8`, `1B.6` |
| `IAEA Board passes resolution against Iran on cooperation, inspectors` | Reuters | 2024-06-05 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaea-board-passes-resolution-against-iran-on-cooperation-inspectors-3472087) | The IAEA Board called on Iran to reverse its barring of inspectors, after Iran removed many experienced inspectors. This undercuts any claim that Khamenei’s system was simply prioritizing sober defensive risk management. | `2B.3`, `1B.4`, `1B.7`, `1B.9` |
| `Iranian commander warns Tehran could review 'nuclear doctrine' amid Israeli threats` | Reuters | 2024-04-18 | [link](https://www.yahoo.com/news/iranian-commander-warns-tehran-could-114201991.html) | A senior IRGC commander in charge of nuclear security said Israeli threats could push Tehran to review and deviate from doctrine. This is conditional brinkmanship: security language is fused with threat inflation and coercive signaling. | `2B.3`, `1B.2`, `1B.3`, `1B.5`, `1B.7` |
| `Iran to change nuclear doctrine if existence threatened, adviser to supreme leader says` | Reuters | 2024-05-09 | [link](https://www.dawn.com/news/1832474) | Kamal Kharrazi, an adviser to Khamenei, said Iran would alter its nuclear doctrine if its existence were threatened. This explicitly ties nuclear posture to regime-survival logic rather than to narrow defensive necessity. | `2B.3`, `1B.2`, `1B.6` |

**Assessment**

- **Evidence for distinguishing defense from politics:** limited and mainly found in the April 19 no-retaliation episode and the IAEA negotiation channel.
- **Evidence against clear distinction:** much stronger. Khamenei publicly cast strikes as proof of power, urged allies to intensify struggle, and his orbit used existential threats to justify doctrinal deviation.
- **Net reading for 2024:** he **did not consistently separate genuine defensive security from prestige, revenge, nationalism, and regime-survival framing**.

**Search gap**

- I did **not** find a strong 2024 source showing Khamenei explicitly and cleanly saying, in substance, “this action is only for defense and not for prestige or regime survival.”
- I also did **not** find evidence of overt “manufactured threats” in a documentable sense. The best-supported reading is broader: he and his circle repeatedly used security threats to justify escalatory policy, which leaves the defensive/non-defensive distinction blurred rather than clarified.
